Pure MATLAB NIfTI I/O subset by Jimmy Shen (2014).

Included as an unchanged subset of the NIfTI_20140122 toolbox.
See `license.txt` for copyright and redistribution terms.
Only load/save untouch entry points and their dependencies are included.
No spatial resampling or affine3d dependency. Intensity scaling is handled by
`../../dtcwtNiftiIO.m`, outside these unchanged vendor files.
